Gitboard serves as a local code-change dashboard for GitLab and GitHub, providing developers with a centralized view of CI status, open merge requests, pull requests, and failed job triage. By integrating with `gh`, `glab`, and `git`, it synchronizes remote forge activity with local worktree state to streamline the development workflow directly from the local machine.
